document.abstract: Pollution control and recovery are both of primary importance to modern industry: pollution control, in order to save our environment and recovery to reduce industrial costs. The reverse osmosis system appears to fulfill both requirements ideally in the film laboratory. The recovery of water and heat, plus the reduction of effluent to more-easy-to-handle volumes has been accomplished. The methods by which this has been done and the analytical results of practical tests are discussed and evaluated.
